# TS.dev

> > TS.dev provides TypeScript-focused software development, custom web applications, and business consulting services with emphasis on quality code and user experience design.

The site features professional software development services alongside technical resources including a comprehensive TypeScript style guide based on Google's standards. TS.dev specializes in modern web technologies including TypeScript, Observable, and popular libraries like jQuery and three.js.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript
- Software Development
- Custom Web Development
- User Experience Design
- Business Solutions
- Software Consulting
- Style Guide
- Coding Standards
- Best Practices
- Quality Code
- Web Applications
- Google Standards
- RFC 2119
- Naming Conventions

## Overview

- [TS.dev](https://ts.dev): Homepage for TS.dev software development and business solutions services

## Development Standards & Style Guides

- [TS Style Guide](https://ts.dev/style): TypeScript style guide based on Google's standards with RFC 2119 terminology
